item.title: October Lantern 0.6.19
item.description:
October agents get smarter

  • Agents you start on October now run on Pro AI, our smartest, when you have Lantern Lifetime, a trial or an October plan, and on Lite AI, free, otherwise.
  • The task shows *October · Pro* or *October · Lite*. Settings › Account says which one your agents use.
  • October Harness is updated to its newest version.

Fixes

  • When Claude Code stops to ask permission for something risky, Lantern shows the card even if only Claude's reminder came through. Before, it could show "Needs your answer" with nothing to answer.
  • A chat you just started says "now" in Recent, not "in 0s".

The Windows installer isn't code-signed yet: if Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click More info, then Run anyway.
